entries.0d5b0ad550ce8cca: This business is undertaken by the company and three domestic consolidated subsidiaries (FTC Co., Ltd., Shion Co., Ltd., and Knit Material Co., Ltd.). It manufactures sewing thread, embroidery thread and various crafts threads, and sells them to domestic customers and overseas Group companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,333 million.
entries.2834ae373d5d1357: This business is undertaken by seven overseas consolidated subsidiaries in China, Vietnam and Thailand. It manufactures industrial sewing thread and embroidery thread and sells them to customers in China, other Asian countries, Hong Kong and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,140 million.
